posts.headline: What kind of|*market is this?
posts.sub: Four regimes, read from 14 cross-asset pairs, and what each one means for gold.
posts.shows: The Market regime card: Deflationary risk-off, with the odds bar On 10%, Defl 19%, Infl 25%, Liq 46%, a note that liquidation leads today on day 1 of 2 to confirm, and the balance for gold.
posts.angle: Gold behaves differently in each regime, so the app tells you which one you are trading in.
facts: Regime: deflationary risk-off
Odds: risk-on 10%, deflationary 19%, inflationary 25%, liquidation 46%
On the day shown, liquidation led, day 1 of 2 to confirm
The regime is read from 14 cross-asset pairs

posts.headline: It needs 2 days|*to change its mind.
posts.sub: A challenger must lead on 2 readings in a row, so a one-day swing can't flip the regime.
posts.shows: The 'Which regime?' sheet: deflationary risk-off confirmed at 19%, liquidation leading at 46% on day 1 of 2 to confirm, and the rule that the name only changes after a challenger leads on 2 readings in a row.
posts.angle: The regime call is built to be steady: no flip-flopping on one noisy day.
facts: Deflationary risk-off 19%, confirmed regime
Liquidation 46%, leading on the day shown, day 1 of 2 to confirm
The name only changes once a challenger leads on 2 readings in a row

posts.headline: Watch the regime|*shift.

posts.shows: The 'How the odds have moved' chart: a stacked area of the four regime odds from August to November, captioned 'Over the last month, Liquidation rose from 38% to 46%', with the gold direction list beneath.
posts.angle: A regime is not a switch. You can watch one build before it takes over.
facts: Over the last month, liquidation rose from 38% to 46%
Four regimes: risk-on, deflationary risk-off, inflationary risk-off, liquidation
